author: Scott Manley
description:
Joby Aviation have been developing an EVTOL which they're hoping will be certified for air taxi operations, carrying paying passengers from airports to landing pads in the middle of cities, and recharging quickly. The design they have uses 6 propellors which pivot between vertical lift and horizontal thrust, and this is a completely new way to fly, the FAA has no training standards for these types of aircraft which fall into a new category of 'Powered Lift'. Joby has built a high fidelity simulator which will be used to train the pilots, and I wanted to get on board and actually learn the procedures, not just take it for a joyride.

And I wanted the instructor to throw some problems at me, including a propulsion failure, because pilots need to know how to handle the aircraft when things are going wrong.

Check out Joby aviation:
